acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for the outbound trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip ticket with a promo code is purchased.
The promo code discount amount shown for the return trip in the email confirmation matches the discount applied to the return line item in the order payload.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for both outbound and return trips when a single promo code applies to the entire round-trip order.
The system displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip in the email confirmation when the promo code applies only to the return leg of the trip.
The system renders the email confirmation without errors when a return trip order contains a promo code with a zero or fully-discounted amount on the return line item.
The system does not display a promo code discount amount for the return trip in the email confirmation when no promo code is applied to the order.
The system displays the correct total discount in the email confirmation that equals the sum of the promo code discount amounts shown for the outbound and return trips.

acceptanceCriteria: Given a return-trip order with a promo code applied, the Mozio email confirmation renders a promo code discount line for the outbound trip showing the correct discount amount from the order payload.
Given a return-trip order with a promo code applied, the Mozio email confirmation renders a promo code discount line for the return trip showing the correct discount amount from the order payload.
The promo code discount amount displayed for the return trip in the email confirmation must exactly match the discount value on the return line item in the order payload.

Given a single promo code that applies to the entire round-trip order, the email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trips, each reflecting their respective allocated portions.
Given a promo code that applies only to the return leg, the email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip and shows no promo code discount for the outbound trip.

Given a return-trip order where the promo code results in a zero or fully-discounted amount on the return line item, the email confirmation renders without errors and displays the discount amount as zero or the full fare respectively.
Given a return-trip order with no promo code applied, the email confirmation does not render any promo code discount line for either the outbound or return trip.
The total discount displayed in the email confirmation equals the sum of the promo code discount amounts shown for the outbound and return trips.
after.description: The Mozio email confirmation does not display the promo code discount amount for return trip tickets. When a round-trip order includes a promo code, the discount should be shown for both outbound and return legs, accurately reflecting the amounts from the order payload.
